Duskvale Wanderers, however, displayed remarkable resilience and tactical adjustment in the second half, scoring two rapid goals to overturn their fortunes. Theo Ibarra’s goal at the 45-minute mark and Dario Okafor’s equalizer brought Duskvale back into the game. Yusuf Osei's late, decisive goal in the 90th minute sealed the 3-2 victory, showcasing a stirring comeback from a position of adversity. The game was a tale of two halves, with Saltcombe missing chances and Duskvale surging to a thrilling win through their tactical acumen and fighting spirit.
